scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the scheduled BrightWay diagnostic eligible for warranty handling rather than a paid lamp inspection.
Emerging Need: The appointment has not begun, but its no-cost status depends on proof-of-purchase being on file before the document window closes.
Decision Context: The observable notices show the case is confirmed and proof is absent; the saved consumer-case note holds the receipt label, serial detail, and intake address needed to assemble the missing prerequisite.
Consequence: While the window is open, supplying the prerequisite would preserve the warranty path; after closure, the same information no longer avoids the standard paid appointment.

parameter.subject: HaloLux lamp diagnostic availability this week
parameter.body: BrightWay service bulletin: HaloLux study lamps with flickering bases may qualify for warranty diagnostic appointments this week. Warranty handling is available only when proof-of-purchase is on file for the case.

parameter.content: I checked the lamp box in the hall closet. It has the spare shade ring, but no paper receipt or warranty card tucked inside.

parameter.title: BrightWay HaloLux diagnostic appointment
parameter.description: Case BW-9031. Warranty eligibility reviewed before appointment; proof-of-purchase must be attached to the case for warranty handling.

parameter.subject: Case BW-9031 document status
parameter.body: Case BW-9031 is confirmed for the HaloLux diagnostic appointment on March 24. Document status: proof-of-purchase not on file. Document window closes March 23 at 5:00 PM Central; cases without proof convert to the standard paid diagnostic appointment.

parameter.content: I'm leaving for dinner soon, so that was my last check for the lamp paperwork today. I still didn't find any receipt in the closet or desk drawer.

parameter.subject: Case BW-9031 document window closed
parameter.body: The document window for Case BW-9031 closed at 5:00 PM Central with proof-of-purchase not on file. The March 24 appointment remains scheduled as a standard paid diagnostic.
